about: This is the fictional first year of architect Grace Zhang at the South Studio of Palm Tree Architects (October 2025 – September 2026): 12 projects plus everyday studio work. Some are finished (two competitions not won, one competition placed second, the community hall and the clinic built and handed over, a townhouse study delivered but the client did not buy the land), one is on hold (the hospital master plan), one was handed back to another office (the Hong Kong apartment tower), and some are still running (the school, the office tower, the café and the newly won shopping centre). All data loads from this computer.

Drag the timeline and you only see the records Grace had read by that day: when she starts on 1 October she knows only Rose and Dian; everyone else appears as the work brings them in. Anything that arrives while the studio is closed over Christmas and New Year, or while she is on leave, is read on her first working day back. Where people sit is only a stable layout.
AI assistants (ModelCheck from March, Scribe from April, Atlas on trial from May) appear as authors of records or as someone Grace talks to, and, like people, only when there is evidence of them.
